title: Subfamily Cylloceriinae Wahl, 1990
content: The fauna of the subfamily Cylloceriinae Wahl, 1990 in the Middle East comprises six species in three genera, Allomacrus Foerster, 1869, Cylloceria Schiødte, 1838 and Hyperacmus Holmgren, 1858. Among the Middle Eastern countries, Cylloceriinae have been recorded only from Iran and Turkey (each with four species).
